title: Remote-only users (no local engine, no Pod) are offered ComfyUI in Remote > Language Models
description: Found during MPI-1045 (Fabio, 2026-10-08: out of scope there, own card). A user who skipped the local engine and has no Pod connected (engineGate.js hasNoEngine() true) sees ComfyUI as a pickable backend for Prompt enhancement and Image descriptions in MpiLlmSettings. Until MPI-1045 it was greyed only BY ACCIDENT: the image-describer plugin gate greyed it because the plugin weight was not on disk, with the wrong advice "Install the Image Describer plugin" (the Model Library is engine-gated). MPI-1045 removes that gate, so ComfyUI becomes enabled for these users, and it is the DEFAULT pick. At run time nothing breaks: llmService runnableBackend() turns a comfy pick into endpoint when hasNoEngine() (MPI-856), so the job silently runs on Remote. The bug is the panel: it offers and shows ComfyUI while the work goes to Remote. Fix: MpiLlmSettings reads hasNoEngine() once in _init (it already rebuilds on every open), greys the ComfyUI entry (meta like "Needs the ComfyUI engine") for both rows, and _missing() says the pick runs on Remote until an engine is installed or a Pod connected. A Pod-only user WITH a Pod connected keeps ComfyUI: it runs on the Pod, and MPI-1045 makes the encoder an engineAsset, volume-installed at connect. SHIP WITH OR BEFORE MPI-1045: that card is what un-greys the entry.
